english: Schedule for Electrical Engineering Design Project (졸업프로젝트, Graduation Project), Semester 1, 2027 Academic Year
This notice announces the topic preference (application) process and the overall schedule for the Graduation Project for Semester 1, 2027, as shown below.
Please refer to the schedule below and prepare for the Graduation Project for Semester 1 of the 2027 academic year.
※ How to apply: Department website (학부 홈페이지) > log in to 인트라넷 (Intranet) > 수업 (Classes) > 졸업프로젝트 과제 확인 및 지망 (View and Apply for Graduation Project Topics)
Each lab uploads its project topics

Meet the professor you wish to apply to, then "submit the meeting confirmation form (면담확인서) on paper"
*Form: see the attached document
Office of the staff member in charge (김수진, Kim Su-jin): Building 301, Room 308
(office inside the laboratory)

Assigned after submission of the meeting confirmation form is checked
(the supervising professor's signature is required)

Every 2–3 weeks during March–May
(1 of the 3 sessions is a special lecture on thesis writing)

All students must attend
Exact dates will be announced on the website at the time
Poster presentation in the 1st-floor hallway of Building 301
A separate notice will be posted
